item.title: BLACK PANTHER Director Ryan Coogler Reveals Biggest Lesson He Learned From Chadwick Boseman
item.description: Black Panther director Ryan Coogler has revealed the biggest lesson he learned from working with the late Chadwick Boseman, and reflects on the challenge of shooting Wakanda Forever without him.

item.title: SPIDER-NOIR Stills Reveal "The Spider" And Black Cat; Nicolas Cage Breaks Down His Take On Ben Reilly
item.description: A new look at Prime Video's Spider-Noir TV series has been revealed, featuring Ben Reilly, Cat Hardy, Robbie Robertson, and "The Spider" watching over his city.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE BTS Photo Features New Look At Camila Mendes As Teela & Nicholas Galitzine As He-Man
item.description: Thanks to a scanned image from Empire Magazine, we have a new look at He-Man (Nicholas Galitzine) and Teela (Camila Mendes) from the live-action Masters of the Universe reboot...

item.title: SPIDER-NOIR: New Details On Ben Reilly Name Change And Who Is Playing Silvermane, Black Cat, Sandman
item.description: New details about Prime Video's Spider-Noir series have been revealed, including casting for Silvermane, Sandman, and Black Cat. There's also a good reason Peter Parker is now Ben Reilly.

item.title: HARRY POTTER Star Reveals How HBO Is Expanding The Books With New Scenes - Possible SPOILERS
item.description: Harry Potter star Lox Pratt, who plays Draco Malfoy, has confirmed that the upcoming TV series will include additional scenes not in the movies or books, meant to flesh out the supporting characters.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Reveals Details On The X-Men's Status Quo And Magneto vs. [SPOILER] Plans
item.description: A new Avengers: Doomsday rumour reveals where we'll find the X-Men when the movie begins, and the promise of an epic battle between Sir Ian McKellen's Magneto and an iconic Marvel villain.
